label: calibrated synthetic — not validated against real data; efficiencies and fuel energy density are UNVERIFIED scenario inputs without a knowledge row: route energy, fuel and CO2e per tonne by drivetrain on the Bingham pit road and least-energy A* routes over the real terrain
notes: Produced on the CPU by pitstudio_pipeline.haulage.a2_run (not by the GPU queue); no GPU time is used.

The drivetrain efficiencies and the fuel energy density have no minephys knowledge-table row: they are explicit scenario inputs listed as UNVERIFIED; the electricity emissions need a grid intensity that has no default, so CO2e is shown for diesel only.
